combo_label: Shoes & Footwear × The Blacksmith's Forge × Robin Hood

entries.clue: Last live coal in a grate, still red under its coat of ash
Pronged metal clasp pinned through the chosen hole to fasten a shoe
Yielding to the hammer without cracking, as hot metal is
What an archer takes before loosing, or a purpose held in mind
Wandering medieval singer who carried tales of Robin from town to town
Mender of split seams and worn heels, often working from a kiosk
Wheezing bag squeezed to drive a blast of air into the fire
The Lionheart, a king brought into the story only by far later retellings
Tanned animal skin, supple and creaking, that takes a mirror shine
Poet's word for a fine horse, such as a knight would ride into battle
